# Prétraitement

### Délimitation des zones "Sahara"

Zone_G = Zone saharienne délimitée par latitudes.

Zone_interet = Zone saharienne délimitée par le biome saharien au Nord, et au Sud par la latitude du Géofence Sud.

- Ajout de la colonne Zone_D qui vaut TRUE si lat_mean est entre 17.51 et 28.749

```{r}
DAYTABLE_2026 <- DAYTABLE_2026 %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = lat_mean >= 17.51 & lat_mean <= 28.749)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = lat_mean >= 17.51 & lat_mean <= 28.749)
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
DATA_HF <- DATA_HF %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
```

- Ajout de la colonne Zone_interet

Création de la zone

```{r}
#| include: false
library(sf)
ecoregions <- st_read(here( "Alice/Data_analysis_June_2026/Ecoregions2017/Ecoregions2017.shp"), wkt_filter = st_as_text( st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c( xmin = -20, xmax = 60, ymin = 0, ymax = 40 ), crs = 4326)) ) ) 
names(ecoregions) 
#unique(ecoregions$BIOME_NAME)
#unique(ecoregions$ECO_NAME)

desert <- ecoregions[ecoregions$BIOME_NAME == "Deserts & Xeric Shrublands", ] 
plot(desert["BIOME_NAME"])

sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(sahara["BIOME_NAME"])

tibesti_sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara|Tibesti-Jebel Uweinat", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(tibesti_sahara["BIOME_NAME"])
```

sf de DAYTABLE_2026 et superposition du sf tibesti_sahara

```{r}
DAYTABLE_2026 <- DAYTABLE_2026[complete.cases(DAYTABLE_2026[,c("lon_mean","lat_mean")]),]
pts_sf <- st_as_sf(DAYTABLE_2026, coords = c("lon_mean", "lat_mean"), crs = 4326)

coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
# coords[,1] = longitude, coords[,2] = latitude
lat <- coords[,2]
intersects_vec <- apply(st_intersects(pts_sf, tibesti_sahara, sparse = FALSE), 1, any)

pts_sf$Zone_interet <- ifelse(
  (lat >= 17.51 & lat <= 26.0) | (lat > 26.0 & intersects_vec),
  "Zone_interet",
  NA
)
unique(pts_sf$Zone_interet)
# Check
tab <- table(pts_sf$Zone_interet, useNA = "ifany")
# proportion
prop <- tab / sum(tab) * 100
prop # 17% de zone interet
# Add Zone_interet to data
DAYTABLE_2026$Zone_interet <- pts_sf$Zone_interet
```

### Ajout de la saison basé sur la date

```{r}
# ADD column "MIGRATION" spring / autumn in the 3 datasets DAYTABLE_2026 et TRACKS_HF_2026
DAYTABLE_2026$date <- as.Date(DAYTABLE_2026$date)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED$date <- as.Date(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED$date)
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT$date <- as.Date(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT$date)

TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT$date <- as.Date(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT$date)
DATA_HF$date <- as.Date(DATA_HF$date)

DAYTABLE_2026 <- DAYTABLE_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%

    MIGRATION = case_when(

    )

DATA_HF <- DATA_HF %>%

    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",

    )
  )
```

### Variable "age" simplifiée en 1, 2-4, 5+

```{r}
#### Création variable age_group (âge qui change au 1er juillet) ####
fct_age_group <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      age_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(age_year))),  # "adult" -> NA
      age_group = case_when(
        age_num == 1                       ~ "1",
        age_num %in% c(2, 4)               ~ "2-4",
        age_num >= 5 | age_year == "adult" ~ "5+",
        TRUE                               ~ NA_character_   
      ),
      age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("1", "2-4", "5+"))
    ) %>%
    select(-age_num)
}
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
DAYTABLE_2026         <- fct_age_group(DAYTABLE_2026)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED  <- fct_age_group(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED)
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- fct_age_group(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT    <- fct_age_group(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT)
data_sub5             <- fct_age_group(data_sub5)
DATA_HF               <- fct_age_group(DATA_HF)

table(DATA_HF$age_year, DATA_HF$age_group, useNA = "ifany")

# Mina et Henri ont 4 ans en AUTOMNE 2026
```

Le ratio n'est pas le même, beaucoup plus de tracks de HF pour les juvéniles que pour les adultes alors qu'il y a un ratio de seulement X entre le nombre de jours d'adultes et de juvéniles. (probablement à cause de Tibordure du Chilloux qui a de la HF au sud du Mali et au Burkina Faso)

### Suncalc

```{r}

# ALT
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(timestamp_start))
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
 mutate(
    lat = first_lat,
    lon = first_lon,
    Date=date
  )
sun_times <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT,
  keep = c("sunrise"),
  tz = "UTC"
)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- bind_cols(
  TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT,
  sunrise = sun_times$sunrise
)

# Conversion 
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_start = as.POSIXct(timestamp_start, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    timestamp_end   = as.POSIXct(timestamp_end,   format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
  )

# Calcul du temps depuis le lever du soleil
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_moyen = timestamp_start + (timestamp_end - timestamp_start)/2,
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp_moyen, sunrise, units = "hours"))
  )


# SPEED
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(
    lat = location.lat,
    lon = location.long,
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  )
sun_input_speed <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
sun_times_speed <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = sun_input_speed,
  keep = "sunrise",
  tz = "UTC"
)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  left_join(sun_times_speed, by = "date")


names(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED) # sunrise.y

TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, sunrise.y, units = "hours"))
  )
head(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED$temps_depuis_sunrise)


# HEIGHT
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(
    lat = location.lat,
    lon = location.long,
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  )

sun_input_height <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sun_times_height <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = sun_input_height,
  keep = "sunrise",
  tz = "UTC"
) %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE)

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  left_join(sun_times_height, by = "date")


names(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT) # sunrise.y

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, sunrise.y, units = "hours"))
  )
head(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT$temps_depuis_sunrise)

# data_sub5
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    lat = location.lat,
    lon = location.long,
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  )

sun_input_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),

sun_times_sub5 <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = sun_input_sub5,

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%

names(data_sub5) # sunrise.y

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
```

### Gestion des anomalies

```{r}
# TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED
```

# I. Echelle SAHARA

## Distances traversée zone_G

### Calcul distances de traversée par saison

```{r}
# Spring
distances_spring <- data_sub5_spring_G %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(timestamp),
    lon_next = lead(lon.x),
    lat_next = lead(lat.x),
    id_next = lead(ID),
    year_next = lead(year),
    
    dist = ifelse(
      ID == id_next & year == year_next,
      distHaversine(cbind(lon.x, lat.x), cbind(lon_next, lat_next)),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_km = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
distances_spring

# Autumn
distances_autumn <- data_sub5_autumn_G %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(timestamp),
    lon_next = lead(lon.x),
    lat_next = lead(lat.x),
    id_next = lead(ID),
    year_next = lead(year),
    
    dist = ifelse(
      ID == id_next & year == year_next,
      distHaversine(cbind(lon.x, lat.x), cbind(lon_next, lat_next)),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_km = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
distances_autumn
```

### Représentation par age_group et test

```{r}
#### Regroupement ####
conflicts_prefer(lmerTest::lmer)

distances_all <- bind_rows(
  distances_spring %>% mutate(season = "spring"),
  distances_autumn %>% mutate(season = "autumn")
)

# Niveaux dans l'ordre voulu (adapter "5+" en "4+" si tu as choisi l'option B)
niveaux_age <- c("1", "2-4", "5+")

distances_all <- distances_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%                       # retire les âges hors groupes (NA)
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season    = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring")))

table(distances_all$age_group, distances_all$season)  # effectifs par cellule

#### Modèles mixtes ####
lme_dist1 <- lmer(dist_km ~ age_group + season + (1|ID), data = distances_all)
summary(lme_dist1)
lme_dist2 <- lmer(dist_km ~ age_group + season + age_group : season + (1|ID), data = distances_all)
summary(lme_dist2)

AIC(lme_dist1, lme_dist2)

#### Représentation ####
library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(stringr)

# Grille de prédiction avec IC
pred <- ggpredict(lme_dist2, terms = c("season", "age_group"))

new_data <- as.data.frame(pred)
colnames(new_data)[colnames(new_data) == "x"]     <- "season"
colnames(new_data)[colnames(new_data) == "group"] <- "age_group"
new_data$age_group <- factor(new_data$age_group, levels = niveaux_age)

# Couleurs : 1 an en rose, 2-4 ans en orange, 5+ en vert
cols_fill <- c("1" = "#FF6FA5", "2-4" = "#FF9F1C", "5+" = "#00B074")
cols_pts  <- c("1" = "#C2185B", "2-4" = "#C96A00", "5+" = "#00693F")
labs_age  <- c("1" = "1 yr",    "2-4" = "2-4 yrs", "5+" = "≥ 5 yrs")

# Position des saisons sur l'axe x (espacement élargi pour 3 barres)
new_data$season_num      <- ifelse(new_data$season == "autumn", 0, 0.28)
distances_all$season_num <- ifelse(distances_all$season == "autumn", 0, 0.28)

ggplot(new_data, aes(x = season_num, y = predicted,
                     fill = age_group, group = age_group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.21),
           width = 0.21,
           alpha = 0.7,
           color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(data = distances_all,
              aes(x = season_num, y = dist_km, color = age_group),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.02, dodge.width = 0.21),
              alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.035, linewidth = 0.7,
                position = position_dodge(0.21)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.28),
                     labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                     limits = c(-0.15, 0.43)) +
  labs(
    x    = "Season",
    y    = "Distance (km)",
    fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.96),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey50")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "distance_by_season.png",
  path = here("Figures/Figures principales"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

#### Taille d'effet ####
```

## Durée de traversée de la Zone_G

### Calcul de la durée de traversée

```{r}
#### Durée de traversée par groupe d'âge ####
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Fonction commune printemps / automne
calc_duree_traversee <- function(df){
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%                 # retire les âges hors groupes
    mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
    summarise(
      date_debut      = min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
      date_fin        = max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
      duree_traversee = as.numeric(date_fin - date_debut),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

spring_duree_traversee <- calc_duree_traversee(data_sub5_spring_G)
autumn_duree_traversee <- calc_duree_traversee(data_sub5_autumn_G)

spring_duree_traversee
autumn_duree_traversee
str(data_sub5_spring_G)

# Contrôle des effectifs par groupe d'âge
table(spring_duree_traversee$age_group)
table(autumn_duree_traversee$age_group)


#### Date de départ par groupe d'âge ####
# Une liste par saison, un élément par groupe : "1", "2-4", "5+"
date_debut_spring <- split(spring_duree_traversee$date_debut,
                           spring_duree_traversee$age_group)
date_debut_autumn <- split(autumn_duree_traversee$date_debut,
                           autumn_duree_traversee$age_group)

date_debut_spring[["1"]]     # ex. : 1 an au printemps
date_debut_spring[["2-4"]]
date_debut_spring[["5+"]]
date_debut_autumn[["1"]]
date_debut_autumn[["2-4"]]
date_debut_autumn[["5+"]]

# Résumé des dates médianes par groupe (souvent plus utile que les listes brutes)
spring_duree_traversee %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            debut_median = median(date_debut),
            debut_min = min(date_debut),
            debut_max = max(date_debut))
```

```{r}
cols_fill <- c("1" = "#FF6FA5", "2-4" = "#FF9F1C", "5+" = "#00B074")
cols_pts  <- c("1" = "#C2185B", "2-4" = "#C96A00", "5+" = "#00693F")
labs_age  <- c("1" = "1 yr",    "2-4" = "2-4 yrs", "5+" = "≥ 5 yrs")

ggplot(spring_duree_traversee, aes(x = age_group, y = duree_traversee, color = age_group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Age group", y = "Travel time (days)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(autumn_duree_traversee, aes(x = age_group, y = duree_traversee, color = age_group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Age group", y = "Travel time (days)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

#### Regroupement ####
duree_all <- bind_rows(
  spring_duree_traversee %>% mutate(season = "spring"),
  autumn_duree_traversee %>% mutate(season = "autumn")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season    = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring")))

table(duree_all$age_group, duree_all$season)   # effectifs par cellule

#### Modèles mixtes ####
lme_duree1 <- lmer(duree_traversee ~ age_group + season + (1|ID), data = duree_all)
summary(lme_duree1)
lme_duree2 <- lmer(duree_traversee ~ age_group + season + age_group:season + (1|ID), data = duree_all)
summary(lme_duree2)

AIC(lme_duree1, lme_duree2)
performance::r2(lme_duree2)

#### Représentation avec prédictions ####
library(stringr)
library(ggeffects)

pred <- ggpredict(lme_duree2, terms = c("season", "age_group"))
new_data <- as.data.frame(pred)
colnames(new_data)[colnames(new_data) == "x"]     <- "season"
colnames(new_data)[colnames(new_data) == "group"] <- "age_group"
new_data$age_group <- factor(new_data$age_group, levels = niveaux_age)

# Positions x explicites : saisons bien espacées (robuste aux cellules vides)
offsets    <- c("1" = -0.3, "2-4" = 0, "5+" = 0.3)
pos_season <- c(autumn = 0, spring = 1.3)

new_data$season_num  <- pos_season[as.character(new_data$season)]
duree_all$season_num <- pos_season[as.character(duree_all$season)]
new_data$x_pos  <- new_data$season_num  + offsets[as.character(new_data$age_group)]
duree_all$x_pos <- duree_all$season_num + offsets[as.character(duree_all$age_group)]

# Ne garder que les cellules qui ont des données
cellules <- duree_all %>% distinct(age_group, season) %>%
  mutate(age_group = as.character(age_group), season = as.character(season))
new_data_plot <- new_data %>%
  mutate(age_group = as.character(age_group), season = as.character(season)) %>%
  semi_join(cellules, by = c("age_group", "season")) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age))

p_duree <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = new_data_plot,
           aes(x = x_pos, y = predicted, fill = age_group),
           width = 0.28, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = duree_all,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = duree_traversee, color = age_group),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(data = new_data_plot,
                aes(x = x_pos, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_season,
                     labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                     limits = c(-0.6, 1.9)) +
  expand_limits(y = 14) +   # évite que la légende masque les points
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Crossing duration (days)", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.96),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

p_duree

ggsave(here("Figures/Figures principales/duree_by_season.png"),
       plot = p_duree, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

var_season_duration
```

## Distances traversée zone_Z = Zone interet

### Calcul de la distance

```{r}
# Spring
distances_spring <- data_sub5_spring_Z %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(timestamp),
    lon_next = lead(lon.x),
    lat_next = lead(lat.x),
    id_next = lead(ID),
    year_next = lead(year),
    
    dist = ifelse(
      ID == id_next & year == year_next,
      distHaversine(cbind(lon.x, lat.x), cbind(lon_next, lat_next)),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_km = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
distances_spring

# Autumn
distances_autumn <- data_sub5_autumn_Z %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(timestamp),
    lon_next = lead(lon.x),
    lat_next = lead(lat.x),
    id_next = lead(ID),
    year_next = lead(year),
    
    dist = ifelse(
      ID == id_next & year == year_next,
      distHaversine(cbind(lon.x, lat.x), cbind(lon_next, lat_next)),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_km = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
distances_autumn
```

## Durée traversée Zone_Z

### Calcul durées

```{r}
#### Durée de traversée par groupe d'âge (zone Z) ####
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Fonction commune printemps / automne
calc_duree_traversee <- function(df){
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%                 # retire les âges hors groupes
    mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
    summarise(
      date_debut      = min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
      date_fin        = max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
      duree_traversee = as.numeric(date_fin - date_debut),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

spring_duree_traversee <- calc_duree_traversee(data_sub5_spring_Z)
autumn_duree_traversee <- calc_duree_traversee(data_sub5_autumn_Z)

spring_duree_traversee
autumn_duree_traversee
str(data_sub5_spring_Z)

# Contrôle des effectifs par groupe d'âge
table(spring_duree_traversee$age_group)
table(autumn_duree_traversee$age_group)


#### Date de départ par groupe d'âge ####
# Une liste par saison, un élément par groupe : "1", "2-4", "5+"
date_debut_spring <- split(spring_duree_traversee$date_debut,
                           spring_duree_traversee$age_group)
date_debut_autumn <- split(autumn_duree_traversee$date_debut,
                           autumn_duree_traversee$age_group)

date_debut_spring[["1"]]
date_debut_spring[["2-4"]]
date_debut_spring[["5+"]]
date_debut_autumn[["1"]]
date_debut_autumn[["2-4"]]
date_debut_autumn[["5+"]]

# Résumé par groupe (dates médianes, min, max)
spring_duree_traversee %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            debut_median = median(date_debut),
            debut_min    = min(date_debut),
            debut_max    = max(date_debut))

autumn_duree_traversee %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            debut_median = median(date_debut),
            debut_min    = min(date_debut),
            debut_max    = max(date_debut))
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         MIGRATION = factor(MIGRATION, levels = c("autumn", "spring")),
         season    = MIGRATION)

table(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_Z$age_group, TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_Z$MIGRATION)  # effectifs par cellule

                    data = TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_Z)

r2_height
# R² marginal  = variance expliquée par les effets fixes seuls

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_Z$x_pos <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_Z$season_num +
  offsets[as.character(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_Z$age_group)]
```

## Tortuosité (distance) sur le SAHARA

(Avec day_dist_3 = Somme des distances par jour entre chaque point à 5min d'intervalle calculé comme ddist_2D_for_day_dist_3 \<- data_sub5_day\$ddist_2D)

```{r}
#### Calcul de la tortuosité ####
library(dplyr)
library(geosphere)
library(writexl)
library(flextable)
library(here)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

#### Fonction : départ/arrivée depuis data_sub5, distance réelle depuis la daytable ####
#### Fonction : tout à partir de data_sub5 (positions à 5 min) ####
calc_tortuosite <- function(data_sub5_Z, daytable, type_migration, saison){
  
  pts <- data_sub5_Z %>%
    filter(!is.na(location.long), !is.na(location.lat), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
    mutate(year = lubridate::year(timestamp)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year) %>%
    arrange(timestamp, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Distance entre positions successives (m), NA pour la 1re position
      seg_dist = c(NA, distHaversine(cbind(location.long[-n()], location.lat[-n()]),
                                     cbind(location.long[-1],   location.lat[-1])))
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      lon_depart   = first(location.long),
      lat_depart   = first(location.lat),
      lon_arrivee  = last(location.long),
      lat_arrivee  = last(location.lat),
      date_depart  = first(timestamp),
      date_arrivee = last(timestamp),
      n_positions  = n(),
      dist_totale  = sum(seg_dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,   # km, même source que dist_min
      age_group    = first(age_group),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(dist_min = distHaversine(c(lon_depart, lat_depart),
                                    c(lon_arrivee, lat_arrivee)) / 1000) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      # Nombre de jours calendaires entre départ et arrivée (pour contrôle)
      n_jours    = as.numeric(as.Date(date_arrivee) - as.Date(date_depart)) + 1,
      tortuosite = dist_totale / dist_min,
      type       = type_migration,
      season     = saison
    )
  
  pts
}

#### -- Montée - Printemps ####
tortuosite_spring <- calc_tortuosite(data_sub5_spring_Z, DAYTABLE_2026_spring_Z, "Montee", "spring")

#### -- Descente - Automne ####
tortuosite_autumn <- calc_tortuosite(data_sub5_autumn_Z, DAYTABLE_2026_autumn_Z, "Descente", "autumn")

#### Regroupement : Printemps + Automne ####
tort_all <- bind_rows(tortuosite_spring, tortuosite_autumn)

#### Anomalies ####
tort_all <- tort_all[!(tort_all$ID == "Barben" & tort_all$year == 2021), ]  # Anomalie

# Contrôle : trajets suspects à examiner
tort_all %>%
  filter(is.na(dist_totale) | tortuosite < 1 | dist_min < 900) %>%
  select(ID, year, type, date_depart, date_arrivee, n_jours,
         lat_depart, lat_arrivee, dist_totale, dist_min, tortuosite)

str(tort_all)

#### Export Excel ####
write_xlsx(tort_all, here("Figures/tortuosite.xlsx"))

#### Tableau ####
ft <- tort_all %>%
  mutate(across(c(lat_depart, lat_arrivee), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(c(dist_totale, dist_min), ~ round(.x, 0)),
         tortuosite  = round(tortuosite, 2),
         date_depart  = format(date_depart,  "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
         date_arrivee = format(date_arrivee, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) %>%
  select(ID, year, age_group, type, date_depart, date_arrivee, n_jours,
         lat_depart, lat_arrivee, dist_totale, dist_min, tortuosite) %>%
  rename(
    "ID"                          = ID,
    "Year"                        = year,
    "Experience"                  = age_group,
    "Migration"                   = type,
    "Start date"                  = date_depart,
    "End date"                    = date_arrivee,
    "N days"                      = n_jours,
    "Start lat"                   = lat_depart,
    "End lat"                     = lat_arrivee,
    "Total distance (km)"         = dist_totale,
    "Straight-line distance (km)" = dist_min,
    "Tortuosity"                  = tortuosite
  ) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  bold(part = "header")

ft
save_as_docx(ft, path = here("Figures/tortuosity_table_correct.docx"))
```

```{r}
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_season,
                     labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                     limits = c(-0.6, 1.9)) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Tortuosity", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.96),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey50"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50", hjust = 0)
  )

p_tort

       plot = p_tort, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Regroupement des pourcentages de variations

```{r}
#### Export des tableaux de variation d'âge (3 groupes) ####
library(officer)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Mise en forme d'un tableau : colonnes 1 / 2-4 / 5+ et variations relatives au groupe 5+
make_ft <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(variable, season, `1`, `2-4`, `5+`, var_1_vs_5plus, var_2_3_vs_5plus) %>%
    mutate(across(c(`1`, `2-4`, `5+`), ~ round(.x, 2)),
           across(c(var_1_vs_5plus, var_2_3_vs_5plus), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
    rename(
      "Variable"               = variable,
      "Season"                 = season,
      "1 yr"                   = `1`,
      "2-4 yrs"                = `2-4`,
      "≥ 5 yrs"                = `5+`,
      "1 yr vs ≥ 5 yrs (%)"    = var_1_vs_5plus,
      "2-4 yrs vs ≥ 5 yrs (%)" = var_2_3_vs_5plus
    ) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    autofit() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    bold(part = "header")
}

doc <- read_docx()

#### Tableau 1 : effet de l'âge sur les variables de performance de vol ####
var_age_performance <- bind_rows(
  var_age_height %>% mutate(variable = "Height"),
  var_age_speed  %>% mutate(variable = "Speed"),
  var_age_alt    %>% mutate(variable = "Altitude gain")
)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  "Age-related variation in flight performance variables",
  style = "heading 1"
)
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, value = make_ft(var_age_performance))

#### Tableau 2 : effet de l'âge sur les variables de mouvement ####
var_age_movement <- bind_rows(
  var_age_tort     %>% mutate(variable = "Tortuosity"),
  var_age_duration %>% mutate(variable = "Duration"),
  var_age_dist     %>% mutate(variable = "Distance")
)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  "Age-related variation in movement variables",
  style = "heading 1"
)
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, value = make_ft(var_age_movement))

#### Export ####
print(doc, target = here("Figures/variation_age_variables.docx"))
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false

# Montée (printemps)

# -------------------------------
# PRINTEMPS - Montée
# -------------------------------

# Modèles linéaires / polynomiaux
mod1 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ 1 + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod2 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod3 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod4 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod5 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + age_group + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)

# Résumé et comparaison AIC
summary(mod1); summary(mod2); summary(mod3); summary(mod4); summary(mod5)
AIC(mod1, mod2, mod3, mod4, mod5)

# Modèle choisi
mod4 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
summary(mod4) # OK
# Axe pour les prédictions
heure_seq <- seq(
  min(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.1
)

groupes <- c("juvenile", "adult")

# Graphique vide
plot(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise, type = "n",
     data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z,
     xlab = "Temps depuis le lever du soleil (h)",
     ylab = "Gain d'altitude",
     main = "Gain d'altitude - Printemps",
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.3, cex.main = 1.6,
     las = 1, font.axis = 2)

# Ajouter les points réels
for (groupe in groupes) {
  points(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise[TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$age_group == groupe],
         TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$alt_gain_30min[TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$age_group == groupe],
         pch = 1,
         col = ifelse(groupe == "juvenile", "deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1"),
         cex = 0.5)
}

# Boucle prédiction + IC
for (groupe in groupes) {
  x <- data.frame(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = heure_seq,
    age_group = factor(rep(groupe, length(heure_seq)), levels = levels(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$age_group))
  )
  
  y <- predict(mod4, newdata = x, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  col_main <- ifelse(groupe == "juvenile", "deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1")
  col_ci   <- ifelse(groupe == "juvenile", "lightpink", "lightgoldenrod1")
  
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit, col = col_main, lwd = 2)
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit + 2*y$se.fit, col = col_ci, lty = 2)
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit - 2*y$se.fit, col = col_ci, lty = 2)
}

legend("topleft", legend = c("Juveniles", "Adultes"),
       col = c("deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1"),
```

```{r}
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit, col = col_main, lwd = 2)
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit + 2*y$se.fit, col = col_ci, lty = 2)
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit - 2*y$se.fit, col = col_ci, lty = 2)
}

legend("topleft", legend = c("Juvéniles", "Adultes"),
       col = c("deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1"), pch = 1, lwd = 2,
       title = "Groupe", cex = 1)

abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50") # lever du soleil


# -------------------------------
# AUTOMNE - Vitesse GPS médiane
# -------------------------------

modv5 <- lm(ground.speed ~ 1, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv6 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv7 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv8 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv8b <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group + temps_depuis_sunrise:age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv9 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)

summary(modv5); summary(modv6); summary(modv7); summary(modv8); summary(modv8b); summary(modv9)
AIC(modv5, modv6, modv7, modv8, modv8b, modv9)

# Modèle choisi
modv8 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
summary(modv8)

# Séquence pour prédiction
temps_seq <- seq(
  min(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.1
)

groupes <- c("juvenile", "adult")

# Graphique vide
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
plot(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z, type = "n",
     xlab = "Temps depuis le lever du soleil (h)",
     ylab = "Vitesse-sol GPS (km/h)",
     main = "Vitesse-sol GPS - Automne",
     xlim = c(min(temps_seq), max(temps_seq)),
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.3, cex.main = 1.6,
     las = 1, font.axis = 2)

# Points réels
cols <- c("aquamarine3", "brown")
i <- 1
for (groupe in groupes) {
  points(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise[TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$age_group == groupe],
         TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$ground.speed[TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$age_group == groupe],
         pch = 1, col = cols[i], cex = 0.5)
  i <- i + 1
}

# Courbes de prédiction + IC
i <- 1
for (groupe in groupes) {
  x <- data.frame(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = temps_seq,
    age_group = factor(rep(groupe, length(temps_seq)), levels = groupes)
  )
  y <- predict(modv8b, newdata = x, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  lines(temps_seq, y$fit, col = cols[i], lwd = 2)
  lines(temps_seq, y$fit + 2*y$se.fit, col = cols[i], lty = 2)
  lines(temps_seq, y$fit - 2*y$se.fit, col = cols[i], lty = 2)
  i <- i + 1
}

legend("topleft", legend = groupes, col = cols, pch = 1, lwd = 2)
abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50") # lever du soleil
```
